deploy-bot: Started deploy to sandbox · env=sandbox · ref=refs/tags/sweeplight-2026-03 · commit=ab12c3d · initiated_by=@sam · change_window=2026-03-18T23:15:00Z/2026-03-18T23:45:00Z

sam: Kicking off preflight smoke now. I triggered the smoke suite `smoke/sandbox/basic` (3 tests).

linh: I'll watch latency and error-rate dashboards. Will alert if 5m error rate >0.5% or p95 latency +30% vs baseline. :eyes:

maria: Reminder: pin config service version to `config:v1.4.2` in rollout spec so canary and main match. I just pushed the pin to the deploy draft.

alex: Uploaded short release notes to the docs bucket: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/sweeplight-2026-03.md — includes known perf caveat on quantized kernels.

deploy-bot: Smoke checks started: test1=running, test2=running, test3=running

deploy-bot: Smoke checks result: test1=pass, test2=pass, test3=pass -> smoke suite passed (3/3).

deploy-bot: Advancing to canary rollout: canary=10% traffic, strategy=linear(10->100, 10m steps), pinned_config=config:v1.4.2

joel: Canary began. Observing metrics. Rolling to 10% now.

linh: Noticing a small latency blip on the K80 cluster at 23:28 UTC — p95 jumped ~45ms for ~90s, error-rate still <0.1%. Investigating KV cache warms.

sam: Can you check kernel selection logs? `kubectl logs deploy/runtime -n sandbox | grep kernel-select`

linh: Found repeated fallback to fallback-kernel for some quantized shards. Logs: `kernel-select: shard=12 -> fallback-kernel (quant mismatch)`

maria: Is this limited to quantized model variants? If so we should pause canary and avoid wider rollout until we validate quantization profile.

deploy-bot: Canary paused at 10% by policy: anomaly_detected=true · reason=kernel-fallbacks · actions=[pause,notify]

joel: Pausing and collecting traces. Can we snapshot the canary logs and KV caches? sam, can you approve a rollback if needed?

sam: Give me 10 minutes to validate traces. If fallback is causing increased p95, we'll rollback to previous tag.

linh: Traces show a miscompiled kernel on subset of GPU nodes (driver mismatch). Affected nodes: gpu-ops-07, gpu-ops-09. Impact: fallback->higher latency, but not increased error rate.

maria: Ops, I can cordon gpu-ops-07 and 09 and redeploy the runtime build with corrected driver flag, but that could take ~8-12m. Alternative: roll back to tag `sweeplight-2026-02` which used older kernel selection and was stable.

sam: Decision: safety-first. Rollback to `sweeplight-2026-02` (commit=ef34c9a) for sandbox canary, then repro on dedicated test infra. Joel — please start rollback. 

joel: Triggering rollback: `deploy-bot rollback --env=sandbox --target-ref=refs/tags/sweeplight-2026-02 --reason="kernel-fallbacks on canary"`

deploy-bot: Rollback started · target_ref=refs/tags/sweeplight-2026-02 · commit=ef34c9a

d eploy-bot: Rolling back canary... (steps: scale-down new pods, scale-up previous, reapply pinned config)

deploy-bot: Rollback progress: scale-down new=done, scale-up old=done, config reapplied=pinned(config:v1.4.2)

deploy-bot: Rollback complete · status=success · finish_time=2026-03-18T23:42:00Z

sam: Post-rollback smoke run started.

deploy-bot: Post-rollback smoke checks: test1=pass, test2=pass, test3=pass

linh: Metrics back to baseline, p95 stable, no more kernel fallbacks observed. Marking incident as transient infra-driver mismatch.

maria: Filing follow-up ticket: INF-892 - investigate driver mismatch rollout gating and add node-level preflight. Added checklist to the release notes.

alex: Updated release notes with rollback summary and mitigation steps. Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/sweeplight-2026-03-rollback.md

sam: Thanks everyone. We'll reattempt sweeplight-2026-03 after infra remediation and a small canary-only run on test infra. Closing this deploy thread. :white_check_mark:
